lines.label: Vendor booth fees
lines.note: 77 paid booths · 12 food truck / open cooking × $750 · 5 drinks × $500 · 40 merchant, craft, and snack × $150 · 5 corporate × $500 · 15 nonprofit × $75

lines.label: Parking
lines.note: About 1,000 cars a day (6,000 guests, about 3 per car, over 2 days) × $10 a day, minus about 20% for parking staff · 1,098 paid spaces

lines.label: Carnival share
lines.note: Our 20% share of carnival ride sales · 2026 earned $3,071 on Saturday alone (Sunday rides closed for wind) · 2027 counts about 1.7 days’ worth, since Super Bowl Sunday runs shorter
